dream: The wedge grew thin, its sharp edge melting into the air. I pressed harder, but the stack slid sideways, dragging the shovel along with it. The lean broke, tipping the whole world onto its side. Then the dark cone dropped from the ceiling, heavy and slow, landing squarely on my forehead. I felt the roof warm up, making the hay squish under my feet, before the card hummed down to a whisper and I drifted back into the quiet.
